_comment: Strategy card explanation lines. api-gateway dataLoadingStrategySteps (handlers/pipelines.go) sends them as explanation_steps; the frontend's computeStrategySteps (lib/pipeline/dataLoadingStrategy.ts) builds the same lines when a strategy arrives without them. Each case's input uses the frontend DataLoadingStrategy field names. Tests: handlers/data_loading_strategy_golden_test.go, frontend/src/lib/pipeline/__tests__/dataLoadingStrategyGolden.test.ts.
name: batch, manual, defaults
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs when you click Run
Reruns: Default is Resume (continue from last checkpoint)

name: batch, active schedule, reload, dataset
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs automatically on schedule
Reruns: Default is Reload (rebuild from scratch)
Destination layout: Write under dataset "analytics"

name: batch, paused schedule counts as manual
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs when you click Run
Reruns: Default is Resume (continue from last checkpoint)

name: batch, case and spaces in schedule and rerun
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs automatically on schedule
Reruns: Default is Reload (rebuild from scratch)

name: unknown mode is batch; unknown rerun is resume
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs when you click Run
Reruns: Default is Resume (continue from last checkpoint)

name: cdc, initial snapshot, dataset
steps: Backfill: Take an initial snapshot of selected tables
Keep in sync: Stream INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE continuously (CDC)
Reruns: CDC is continuous; use Restart CDC to recover if needed
Destination layout: Write under dataset "raw"

name: cdc, no cdc mode means snapshot
steps: Backfill: Take an initial snapshot of selected tables
Keep in sync: Stream INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE continuously (CDC)
Reruns: CDC is continuous; use Restart CDC to recover if needed

name: cdc, streaming only, upper-case mode; schedule and rerun ignored
steps: Backfill: Skip historical backfill (start streaming new changes only)
Keep in sync: Stream INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE continuously (CDC)
Reruns: CDC is continuous; use Restart CDC to recover if needed

name: blank dataset adds no layout line
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs when you click Run
Reruns: Default is Resume (continue from last checkpoint)

name: dataset is trimmed and shown as typed, quotes included
steps: Backfill: Take an initial snapshot of selected tables
Keep in sync: Stream INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE continuously (CDC)
Reruns: CDC is continuous; use Restart CDC to recover if needed
Destination layout: Write under dataset "sales "eu""

name: dataset with a backslash and non-ASCII is shown as typed
steps: Backfill: Copy selected tables in batch runs (historical snapshot)
Keep in sync: Runs when you click Run
Reruns: Default is Resume (continue from last checkpoint)
Destination layout: Write under dataset "exports\q3 café"
